title: FOOD-005D - Fulfillment intent, capacity requirements and reservation-request contracts
purpose: Define pure fulfillment-intent and reservation-request contracts derived from exact FOOD-005C merchandise quote snapshots without claiming that inventory, production capacity or fulfillment capacity has actually been atomically reserved.

decisions.fulfillmentIntent: A fulfillment intent is an immutable versioned customer/request selection bound to one exact FOOD-005C merchandise quote version. It selects personal-delivery or meetup plus opaque location/window references. It does not mean the request is supported, approved, scheduled or fulfilled.
decisions.availabilityVsCapacity: Availability is not capacity. Public/menu availability remains separate. FOOD-005D derives capacity demand only; it creates no quantity-on-hand, available-quantity, batch inventory, slot inventory or storage truth.
decisions.reservationOwnership: FOOD-005D owns reservation-request contracts only. It does not mint an authoritative inventory or slot hold.
decisions.reservationQuantity: Capacity demand is the positive safe-integer SKU purchase quantity copied exactly from each FOOD-005C quote line. Package internal mass/count and recipe grams are not reservation quantities.
decisions.identityVersioning: Fulfillment intent and reservation request each have stable identities and positive safe-integer versions. Initial version is one; revisions are consecutive full replacements.
decisions.expiration: No reservation expiration, hold timeout or implicit clock is introduced because this slice creates no committed hold and repository evidence does not establish an expiration policy.
decisions.fulfillmentMethods: Only personal-delivery and meetup are represented. Pickup, shipping and third-party courier fulfillment are not introduced.
decisions.concurrency: Pure domain contracts cannot prevent overselling. Atomic capacity checks, compare-and-set, transactions, idempotency and conflict handling belong to a future persistence/service authorization.
decisions.orderBoundary: A reservation request is not an order, not a confirmed reservation, not checkout readiness and not payment readiness.
decisions.futureOrderHandoff: FOOD-005E may consume exact quote and fulfillment-intent/request references, but must not treat a FOOD-005D reservation request as proof of reserved capacity. A separately trusted capacity-reservation acceptance seam is required before order truth may claim capacity is held.

FoodCapacityRequirementLine: derived from exact FOOD-005C quote lines

operations: Exactly three local files only. No staging, commit, push, persistence mutation, production access or deployment.
